title: Lazy-load node:sqlite to selectively suppress only its ExperimentalWarning
context: Top-level import of node:sqlite printed ExperimentalWarning on every CLI invocation, breaking the release gate's clean-stderr contract. This module's stderr reaches humans, hooks, and MCP clients, making cleanliness critical.
decision: Use lazy dynamic loading via createRequire with selective process.emitWarning interception to suppress only SQLite's experimental warning, caching the module for reuse. Mirrors existing pattern in src/store/db.ts.
consequences: Passes clean-stderr contract; unblocks release gate
Other warnings still propagate (selective filtering, not blanket suppression)
Lazy loading adds minimal runtime overhead, offset by singleton caching
Establishes reusable pattern for handling experimental dependencies
alternatives_rejected: Global warning suppression: Too broad, could hide real issues
Ignoring the warning: Failed release gate expectations
Replacing with non-experimental SQLite library: No viable alternative
